overview_description.description:
Spokn brings human connection to remote work.  On Spokn, remote employees can share their voice and find connection through video and audio Stories and podcasts.  It's a more human way to share wins, swap stories about travel and pets, celebrate birthdays and more.  Unlike sad Zoom happy hours or awkward coffee chats, Spokn is designed for what remote employees want: an easy, async and human way to connect from afar. 

Companies like Robinhood, Udemy, 15Five, Snyk, GinkgoBioworks, Podium and more rely on Spokn to help them build a great remote culture.
